decisions.note: RIT Common Data Set 2024-25, Section C, Early Decision I admit rate for Fall 2024 entering class = 72.2%. Cross-referenced via Cosmic College Consulting (reading CDS) and confirmed RIT offers ED I (Nov 1) and ED II (Jan 1). Trend: 82.9% (F21), 79.0% (F22), 72.8% (F23), 72.2% (F24).

decisions.note: Clarkson University offers Early Decision (Dec 1 deadline, binding). The CDS 2024-25 is published on Clarkson's Institutional Research site via Google Drive viewer, but Section C ED applicant/admit counts are not extractable from the PDF preview and not aggregated by third parties. Overall acceptance rate is ~67%. Manual CDS download required to extract C21 ED admit rate.
